title: incident-bot: add automated diagnostics command and runbook-linking for SLO incidents
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: On-call engineers frequently need an initial diagnostic snapshot when SLOs or alerts fire. This PR adds an automated diagnostics command to incident-bot and integrates runbook linking and a lightweight SLO diagnostic summary from the slo-toolkit. What changed: 1) incident-bot: new slash command /incident-diagnose and background job that collects recent error logs, pod/container states, top-5 traces by latency, and a summarized SLO delta from slo-toolkit; 2) slo-toolkit: exported diagnostics APIs that compute rolling-interval SLO deltas and top contributors; 3) runbooks: standardized runbook templates and metadata for automatic linking in Slack alerts; 4) docs: usage guide and on-call checklist. The description below covers the command UX, data retention considerations, safety/timeouts, and test coverage. This PR aims to reduce time-to-first-action for on-call by providing curated diagnostics and a direct link to the relevant runbook.

Priya Kapoor: Can we redact PII from logs collected by default? Also request opt-in for full logs in orgs that want them.

Jordan Lee: Tests look good. Two small nits on doc wording and a suggestion to pin the slo-toolkit API contract in CI.
Ava Chen: Addressed nits and added a contract test that runs during integration CI and validates response shapes between incident-bot and slo-toolkit.
merge_outcome: Merged by Priya Kapoor via squash merge. Commit message: 'incident-bot: add /incident-diagnose and automated diagnostics + runbook linking (ENG-3245)'. Release note: Adds an automated diagnostics command to incident-bot which posts a curated diagnostics summary and runbook link to Slack; configurable redaction and runtime limits.
release_notes: - incident-bot: new /incident-diagnose command that collects logs, traces, and an SLO delta summary from slo-toolkit and links the most relevant runbook. - slo-toolkit: diagnostics API endpoint for rolling SLO deltas and contributor breakdowns. - runbooks: added standardized templates and metadata for automatic linking.
